Checks on other websites

When you run a trace, the app (not our servers) requests the public profile page of your username from each listed site. We cannot see those requests or the results. Do not search for people other than yourself.

Age

The app is intended for adults (18 and over).

Service providers

The app uses these third-party services, which process data on our behalf under their own privacy terms:

  • RevenueCat — subscription and purchase status (privacy policy)
  • Google AdMob — advertising (privacy policy)

Purchases

Subscriptions are processed by Apple or Google. We receive confirmation of your purchase status (through RevenueCat) but never your payment details.

Children

The app is not directed to children under 13 (or the minimum age in your country) and we do not knowingly collect their data.

Your rights

Depending on where you live (for example under the GDPR or the CCPA) you may have the right to access, correct, delete or export your data and to object to certain processing. Contact rizwanrasheed046@gmail.com (or use the support page) and we will respond within 30 days.

Security and transfers

Data is transmitted over encrypted connections. Service providers may process data in countries other than yours.

Changes

If this policy changes materially we will update the date above and, where required, tell you in the app.
